bugs.title: AuditEvent model has no `correlation_id` column
skip_reason_examples: audit-exposed bug awaiting fix: AUDIT-BUG-002 — AuditEvent.correlation_id column missing; cross-channel verification cannot link request → audit row
bugs.notes: Backend AuditEventSerializer (hub/apps/audit/serializers.py:8-29) does not include `correlation_id`; the underlying model has no such column (hub/apps/audit/models.py:21-107). Blocks the full D123 cross-channel guarantee chain — B4 generates a correlation-id, B3 cannot yet cross-check it against the audit row. Fix: backend migration to add the column + propagate from request context.
